deviceKeyId.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (hex) of a device's ECDSA P-256 public key.

pairIdHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the pair identifier; never derived from character name/world.

capabilityId.description: Opaque, high-entropy, unguessable identifier. Only its hash is stored server-side.

nonce.description: 128-bit single-use request-signing nonce, base64url without padding.

aeadNonce.description: 96-bit AES-256-GCM nonce (per protocol/constants.json aead.nonceLengthBytes), base64url without padding.

ecdsaSignature.description: Raw ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 signature (r||s, 64 bytes), base64url without padding.

ecPublicKeyJwk.description: P-256 public key as a JWK, used for both ECDSA (signing) and ECDH (key agreement) device keys.
